answer: Make seniority earned, not waited for. A key's age should count only epochs where it answered and passed peer grading, like a glacier that grows only in snowfall years. Full pay needs 60 passed epochs, and each missed epoch removes 2, so parked keys spiral back toward zero instead of ripening into a relic worth selling. A farm wanting 1,000 trusted keys must publish 60,000 passing answers, roughly 2,000 hours of peer review at 2 minutes each, and every lapse costs it again. Aged-key resale dries up.
